BiblicalUsage: Mortar is the daubing that hides a bad wall. Ezekiel asks, when the wall is fallen, shall it not be said, where is the daubing wherewith ye have daubed it?
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the image is plain: whitewash does not make a wall stand, and the fall exposes what the plaster was hiding.
